title: Ill Gotten Gold... Vegetables, Again
description: Ill Gotten Gold... Vegetables, Again — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 20 Golded Pumpkins and 45 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 20 Golded Pumpkins and 45 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

I need you to head out back to the farms to collect more golded veggies. We are doing some experiments to see if the golded veggies, if boiled long enough, could actually be edible. So far it doesn't look good, but I'm a bit peckish so hopefully it will work.

Run along to the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and collect the required amount of golded vegetables. Once you have them all return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Do you have the golded veggies? Most excellent. Let me know when you are ready to do this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Golded Pumpkins ×20
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×45

Client level range: 80–85
